newsitem.title: USA: Badger Paper Mills chairman retires. [CORRECTED 2:11 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Badger Paper Mills chairman retires. [CORRECTED 2:11 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to make clear that chairman retired, rather than resigned).
Badger Paper Mills Inc on Wednesday said Edwin A. Meyer Jr, its chairman, and Bennie Burish, its former president, retired from its board of directors, effective March 1.
A company spokesman said there was no immediate replacement for Meyer, a director since 1958 and board chairman for the last 21 years.
Badger Paper Mills President and Chief Executive Claude Van Hefty will preside at board meetings for now, the spokesman said.
Badger Paper Mills produces specialty paper products.
